body.condition: There are constants \(0<c_v<C_v<\infty\), locally uniform over compact exponent sets, such that \(c_v\{(nH)^{-1}+(ng)^{-1}\}\le s^2\le C_v\{(nH)^{-1}+(ng)^{-1}\}\).

novel.justification: This nondegeneracy condition allows donor-window and treated-pre score components to determine the larger sampling scale and rules out cancellation only at the variance level.
